title: Return orders to the tool-check queue
description: Orders that have a tool result (toolResult) but no tool result note. Clearing toolResult puts them back in the queue for the external tool to check again.
warning: If the 6 changed tool-check codes (designReviewCode) have not been fixed, orders returned to the queue will be answered no-tool again and then MOVE TO A DESIGNER for manual work. Nothing breaks, but sending over a thousand orders to designers at once is an overload. Run a small batch (about 50 orders) first to see how the tool reacts.
onlyClears: The only write: clearing toolResult to empty, through the order log (the old value stays in the log — the only way back). An order that already has a tool result note is never touched.

block.has-note: Already has a tool result note — someone is working it, not touched
block.held: On hold — release the hold first
block.excluded-factory: Out-of-flow factory (US) — the queue excludes it
block.skip-tool-check: Factory has Skip tool check on — the queue excludes it
